name: dark
note: AoE2 wiki "Random map", Starting Age: a start in an age researches the technologies of all earlier ages (#2265)

name: post-imperial
note: AoE2 wiki "Post-Imperial Age": all technologies, not Spies/Treason, Flemish Revolution, First Crusade (not in the game program)

name: turbo
note: AoE2 wiki "Turbo Random Map": buildings work, villagers and fishing ships gather, carry and villagers build 2.5 times faster; not the slow items (#2359)

name: regicide
help: each player has a King, a player whose King dies is defeated
note: AoE2 wiki "Regicide (game mode)": each player starts with a King, a player whose Kings all died is defeated (#2347) · the starting resources of each level, a Castle and 7 more villagers (the random map scripts: "if REGICIDE"), Treason in place of Spies (#2388)

name: scenario
help: each player starts with the resources and the population limit of the scenario
note: AoE2 DE scenario editor, tab "Players": the start resources and the population limit of each player (#2540)

name: wonder-race
help: no player can attack another, the first complete wonder wins
note: AoE2 wiki "Wonder Race": no player can attack another player, the first player with a complete wonder wins (#2406)

name: empire-wars
help: each player starts with a town and 27 villagers at work, in the Feudal Age when --age is dark
note: AoE2 wiki "Empire Wars" (DE): Feudal Age, a mill, 3 lumber camps, a mining camp, 6 houses, 5 farms, a barracks and 27 villagers: 4 on gold, 12 on wood, 6 on food (2 on farms, 4 on berry bushes) and the rest idle at the sheep under the town center, here on food too; the Scout of the scenario stays (#2408)

name: sudden-death
help: one town center, a player who loses it is defeated
note: AoE2 wiki "Sudden Death": each player can have only one town center, a player who loses it is defeated (#2407)

name: death-match
help: the ultra resources when --resources is standard, the Post-Imperial Age when --age is dark
note: AoE2 wiki "Deathmatch": all players start with 20000 food, 20000 wood, 10000 gold and 5000 stone (the "ultra" level); the Definitive Edition starts it in the Post-Imperial Age by default, without Spies (#2438)

name: capture-the-relic
help: the first player who brings the relic of the map center into an own monastery wins
note: AoE2 wiki "Capture the Relic": one relic at the map center, the first player who brings it into an own monastery wins at once (#2440)

name: battle-royale
help: the Post-Imperial Age, the high resources and no stone, no town center and no villagers; the Corruption takes the map from its border to its center (battle_royale.py)
note: AoE2 wiki "Battle Royale": the Corruption takes the map from its border to its center (battle_royale.py, #2439); "The mode starts out in the Post-Imperial Age with each player having just two hero units. As Town Centers and Villagers are not part of the game mode ...", "Stone is entirely absent", recommended Resources High (#2686)

name: defend-the-wonder
help: player 1 defends a Wonder for 250 years, the others win when it falls
note: AoE2 wiki "Defend the Wonder": player 1 defends a Wonder for 250 years, the others attack it; all start in the Post-Imperial Age; 900 of each resource for the defender, 600 for its team mates, 1200 food, 900 wood, 1200 gold and 600 stone for the attackers; each attacker starts with a Castle, each base has a ring of Stone Walls with a gate (#2441, #2462)

name: infinite
note: AoE2 wiki "Random map", Resources: Infinite; a cost does not lower the stock, the start amounts of ultra (#2489)

name: random
note: AoE2 wiki "Random map", Resources: Random, one of the levels (#2489)
